column1: # Decade --min-gain sweep to locate the plateau edges and its center.
# Prior 250-4000 ladder was statistically flat (5-way homogeneity p=0.12/0.27 on
# ntil-47/49) except mg250 dipping on ntil-47 -- a hint the compiled default
# (100) sits near the LOW edge, not the center. This clean decade ladder spans
# one decade below the default to three above:
# mg10 probes below the default; the high end should find the upper cliff (eps so
# large improving moves snap to 0). Center of the good band -> principled default.
# All other knobs at compiled defaults.
